map.：n=10、p=0.5、k=5：C(10,5)=252；P=252×0.5^10: : n=10, p=0.5, k=5: C(10,5) = 252; P = 252 x 0.5^10 = 252/1024 = 0.2461. So five successes in ten attempts has probability about 24.6%.
